text: "While home energy dashboards are great for spotting high-drain appliances, many overlook the hidden maintenance cost of data drift. Over time, smart meters and sensors often need manual recalibration or firmware updates to ensure readings remain accurate. Without active monitoring of the hardware itself, the mental load of troubleshooting 'phantom' spikes can easily offset your actual energy savings. It isn't just a set-and-forget tool; it's a digital appliance that requires its own periodic upkeep to stay reliable."
